title: Iblis refuses to bow to Adam

tellings.quote: Shayan refused to bow before Allah's creation, namely Adam

plain: In Islamic tradition, Iblis, also called Shaytan, the devil, refused to bow before God's new creation, Adam. The researcher Jason Jorjani retells this old story to Michels, putting it as Shaytan refusing "to bow before Allah's creation, namely Adam". He uses it as a story about a powerful non-human being who will not serve humankind.
